Percius has a collection of marbles. 40% of them are clear. 20% are black, and the remainder are all the other colors. A friend of his asks if he can take five marbles. On average, how many marbles of other colors will his friend end up getting?

Given:
- 40% of the marbles are clear.
- 20% of the marbles are black.
- The remainder are other colors.

First, calculate the percentage of marbles that are other colors:
- 100% - 40% - 20% = 40% of the marbles are other colors.

Next, determine the average number of other colored marbles in a sample of five marbles:
- Since 40% of the marbles are other colors, on average, 40% of the five marbles will be other colors.
- 40% of 5 = 0.40 * 5 = 2.

So, on average, the friend will get 2 marbles of other colors.

FINAL: 2
